# The AI Infra Ecosystem Map
> 290 companies across the five-layer AI stack, with deep analytical cards on selected infrastructure providers. Maintained by Rahul Patwardhan. Public facts verified and dated; corrections shipped within a week.

## Analysis
- [The Compute Ladder](https://aiinfraecosystem.netlify.app/compute-ladder.html): Framework — every AI infrastructure provider sells a different unit of consumption, from megawatts to tokens. Includes the seven-company comparison matrix (unit sold, unit bought, silicon, scale, natural buyer).

## Company cards (verified July 2026)
- [Firmus](https://aiinfraecosystem.netlify.app/companies/firmus.html): Sells megawatts and whole AI factories. $10B Blackstone-led debt facility; Project Southgate targets 1.6GW by 2028; 100% renewable.
- [GMI Cloud](https://aiinfraecosystem.netlify.app/companies/gmi-cloud.html): Sells GPU clusters and sovereign AI factories. ~7,000 GB300s in Taiwan; $12B/1GW sovereign initiative in Japan.
- [TensorWave](https://aiinfraecosystem.netlify.app/companies/tensorwave.html): Sells AMD Instinct GPU-hours. 8,192 MI325X online; $350M Series B co-led by AMD Ventures; customers include Fireworks AI and Luma AI.
- [Lightning AI](https://aiinfraecosystem.netlify.app/companies/lightning-ai.html): Sells an AI development platform plus GPU compute — its own 35,000+ GPU fleet (post Voltage Park merger) and 7+ third-party clouds via marketplace.
- [Runpod](https://aiinfraecosystem.netlify.app/companies/runpod.html): Sells per-second serverless GPU compute. ~$240M ARR (June 2026), 500K+ developers; also a major buyer of capacity from data-center partners.
- [DeepInfra](https://aiinfraecosystem.netlify.app/companies/deepinfra.html): Sells inference by the token. ~5 trillion tokens/week across eight owned US data centers; ~30% of volume from agents.
- [FriendliAI](https://aiinfraecosystem.netlify.app/companies/friendliai.html): Sells tokens from custom models (serverless, dedicated endpoints, BYO-cluster container) while buying GPU capacity across clouds. Founded by the inventor of continuous batching; exclusive API provider of LG EXAONE.

## Main map
- [The AI Infra Ecosystem Map](https://aiinfraecosystem.netlify.app/): The full 290-company directory across App, Models, Infrastructure, Chips and Energy layers.
